snippet.title: Riven Crown Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on PC - https://store.steampowered.com/app/2976250/Riven_Crown/
Unleash your power. Break the crown.
In Riven Crown, you are not just a warrior, you are the answer to a crumbling kingdom ruled by power and fear. Master brutal, deliberate combat infused with the rhythm of fighting games. Wield armor and weapons that evolve with you. Rescue the forgotten. Shape your legend.
Uncover ancient puzzles, hidden paths, and whispered truths buried within a beautifully interconnected world.
This is a world where blocking the wrong way could be fatal… but learning the right combo could change everything.

Web: https://rivencrown.com/
